resources.string: Magen locks the apps you choose, blocks new installs and protects parts of Settings. It reads on-screen text only to recognise which app or Settings page is open. Nothing leaves your device.
Device admin makes removing Magen require extra steps. Magen does not read or erase your data.
Disabling Magen\'s device-admin permission weakens protection. To remove Magen, use “Approve uninstall” inside the app.

No accounts signed in during setup, and USB debugging
Strong mode makes Magen the Device Owner, so Android itself enforces the rules. It is done once from a computer and takes about five minutes.
On the phone: Settings, About phone, tap Build number 7 times. Then Settings, System, Developer options, and turn on USB debugging.

Android allows this only while no account is signed in. Go to Settings, Passwords and accounts, and remove every account, including Google. You can add them back at the end. Also remove any extra user or work profile.

Download Android platform-tools from developer.android.com/tools/releases/platform-tools, unzip it and open a terminal in that folder. Connect the phone with a USB cable and approve the prompt on the phone.
Run: adb devices. Your phone should be listed as device, not unauthorized.
Run the command below. The answer should start with Success.
Open Magen. Strong mode should show On. Add your accounts back. To remove Magen later, use Approve uninstall in the More tab.

Accounts exist: remove every account and try again.
Several users: delete the extra users.
Xiaomi or Redmi: also turn on USB debugging (Security settings) in Developer options.
Unauthorized: unplug the cable, plug it back in and approve the prompt on the phone.
Remember your master code. Without it, Magen can be removed only by a factory reset.
Magen needs these to work. Android does not let apps switch them on silently, so each button opens the matching Settings screen.
Page names depend on your phone

1. Open the phone\'s Settings. 2. Tap Search and type the feature you want to block. 3. Open the result and note the title at the top. 4. Return to Magen > Rules > Block any other page, enter that title exactly in the phone language and tap Add. You may paste a full path such as Network & internet > Internet; Magen keeps the last part. 5. Open the page again to test. If it still opens, try the title shown inside the page or a manufacturer-specific name. Names vary by device and language; Strong mode enforces only restrictions Android supports at system level.
